reviews.inviteTitle: Ask a regular client for a review
reviews.inviteHint: Record a visit that already happened and get a personal link for the client to rate the professional. Send it by WhatsApp, SMS or however you like. No account needed.
reviews.inviteRules: One link works for one review of one visit. Visits from the last 90 days, one request per client and professional every 30 days. These reviews are labelled “visit confirmed by the salon”, and the salon cannot delete or hide them, negative ones included.
reviews.inviteNoTeam: Add a professional with services in the Team tab to ask for reviews.
reviews.invited: Request created. Now send the message to the client: copy it or open WhatsApp with the buttons below.

inviteErrors.invalid: Check the name, the e-mail (if given) and the date (up to 90 days ago, not in the future).
inviteErrors.duplicate: You already asked this client to review this professional in the last 30 days.
inviteErrors.limit: You reached today's request limit. Try again tomorrow.
inviteErrors.phone: Invalid phone number. Pick the country and type the full number.

reviews.cannotDelete: Salons cannot delete reviews. You can reply publicly or report a fake review to moderation.
